expectations.evidence: The transcript assumes a meeting program will run. It recommends to 'run a free, in-house pilot next edition', and only the matchmaking platform is skipped ('for now'). The post-pilot decision offers two options, 'fold it into the standard package and raise the price' or 'sell it as a tier'. Both keep the program. The open questions at the end are about how to build it, not whether to. Nowhere does it say that running no 1:1 program could be the right outcome for a 300-person engineering event.
